eco2: -2 low party_line -> -2 medium vote: the bloc central, including the EPR group Attal chairs, opposed the Zucman tax, rejected 228-172 on 31 Oct 2025 (Toute l'Europe, JDD). The paraphrased Wikipedia source was replaced.

eco3: +2 medium programme -> +1 medium statement: the programme page cuts employee contributions ('charges salariales'), not employer contributions or production taxes. The draft paraphrase 'reduce employer charges' was wrong. He only says labour costs should not have risen (BFMTV).
eco6: +1 low -> +1 medium: verbatim quote 'faciliter et fluidifier les donations du vivant' confirmed on the AFER page.

ret1: -2 medium record_in_office -> -2 medium statement: outdated basis. His current position (Aug-Sep 2026) is to abolish the legal age altogether, with penalty/bonus. The 2023 reform has been suspended. Sources: Public Sénat, BFMTV/AFP.

trav1: kept -1 medium: replaced the paraphrase with a verbatim programme quote and Midi Libre/AFP 'droit au brut'.

trav2: +2 high programme -> +2 medium record_in_office: the 2027 programme gives no specifics on duration or amount. The +2 rests on his March 2024 PM proposal to cut duration toward 12 months (Boursorama/Reuters).

imm1: kept +1 medium: added JDD (right-lean outlet) corroboration that work immigration is prioritised over family and student immigration.
